note: MDC area spread over five tracts along the Lamine River east of Otterville. Camping is allowed within 50 feet of four designated gravel parking lots, with no amenities; this entry is the one beside Route A near the concrete boat ramp. The others are on the north tract off Wildlife Road and on the south tracts off Potters Ford Road and Wildlife Drive. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Designated Camping Sites', Rule 140 standard; brochure 'four designated camping sites (no amenities)', 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. In these areas, camping is allowed within 50 feet of the parking lot.'; map (12/08/2023) shows four camping symbols at lots. flags: INCLUSION: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; Rule 140 standard, no special-use-permit-only rule, no Rule 101. Brochure (12/2021): 'Facilities / Features: A concrete boat ramp to Lamine River on Hwy A; four designated camping sites (no amenities)'; 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. In these areas, camping is allowed within 50 feet of the parking lot. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply. Groups of more than 10 campers require a special use permit. Stays are limited to a period of fourteen (14) consecutive days in any thirty (30)-day period.' Designated points at lots, so it stays under the lot-camping rule.

CLUSTERS (four camping lots, each a single small gravel lot - none worth a split): GIS 58 = stored pin, beside Route A (map lot 9, just north of the concrete-ramp lot 10 = GIS lot 2363); GIS 61 (38.73000,-92.99213, 2.96 km N), a gravel lot with boulder edging on the north tract off Wildlife Rd (map lot 4, GIS lot 2371), the point in grass 40 m S of the lot; GIS 60 (38.66524,-92.95045, 5.1 km S), a small gravel lot under trees off Potters Ford Rd beside the river (map lot 19, GIS lot 2366); GIS 59 (38.66331,-92.93364, 6.1 km SE, 1.48 km from GIS 60), a gravel lot at a bend of the entrance road off Wildlife Dr (map lot 17, GIS lot 2365). near.py finds no other entry within 3 km of the north or south points.

PIN: stored 38.70542,-92.97902 = GIS 58, in an open grass clearing about 10 m north of the edge of a gravel lot (about 18 x 30 m) on the west side of Route A; not under canopy, within the 50-ft camping band. Kept (lot centre option 38.70520,-92.97894).
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, confirmed): the Lamine River is about 85 m west of the Route A lot through woods.
ACCESS: the Route A lot sits directly on the state highway; no low-water crossing or posted limit seen.
HORSES: brochure 'Bicycles and horses allowed on public roadways year-round.' No horse camp.

PHONE MISMATCH: area page lists '(573) 346-2210'; stored is 573-815-7900, which is the brochure's (12/2021) Central Regional Office number ('3500 E Gans Rd, Columbia, MO 65201, (573) 815-7900'). The map (12/08/2023) also prints '(573) 346-2210'. Suggest phone -> 573-346-2210 (the area page's current number).
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored; the brochure's 'Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply' names no dates.
